premise: Raccoon counts; Ladybug hides under Mushroom's cap, but Bear cub is too big to hide anywhere, so he closes his eyes — if he can't see them… — falls asleep, and his snore gives him away.
inspiration: The folk hide-and-seek game where the biggest can't hide, turned: being found is the fun, and the sleepiest player wins the best nap.
lesson: Being found is part of the fun.

en-US.title: Bear Cub Plays Hide-and-Seek
en-US.text: {raccoon:enter} Raccoon had a game. [excited] "Hide-and-seek! I'll count!" {raccoon:live peekaboo hold} He covered his eyes. "One… two… three…" Quick as a wink, {ladybug:enter} Ladybug spotted {mushroom:enter} Mushroom and {ladybug:go under mushroom} crept under her red cap. {mushroom:face happy} [giggles] "That tickles!" But {bear:enter} Bear cub was far too big to hide. {bear:face sad} Not behind Mushroom. Not behind a rock. {bear:sparkle} Then he had an idea. "If I close my eyes, nobody can see me!" {bear:live nap hold} So he closed his eyes… and nodded off. {sfx:snore} Zzz… zzz… "…eight, nine, TEN!" {raccoon:live peekaboo resume} "Ready or not, here I come!" {raccoon:face happy} Raccoon {raccoon:live listen} listened hard. Zzz… zzz… {raccoon:go to bear} [laughs] "Found you!" {bear:live nap resume} Bear cub woke with a start. {bear:face surprised} "How did you know?" he asked. "You were snoring!" said Raccoon. {mushroom:live sneeze} Mushroom giggled so hard that… ah… ah… {sfx:achoo} ACHOO! {ladybug:go back} Out crawled Ladybug. {all:face happy} {all:hop} "Found you too!" Now it was Bear cub's turn to count. "One… two…" {bear:live nap hold} "three…" [whispers] Zzz. {ladybug:hearts} So everyone hid, and Bear cub had the best nap in the meadow.

es-ES.title: Osito juega al escondite
es-ES.text: {raccoon:enter} Mapache propuso un juego. [excited] —¡Al escondite! ¡Me la quedo yo! {raccoon:live peekaboo hold} Se tapó los ojos. —Uno… dos… tres… Rapidísima, {ladybug:enter} Mariquita vio a {mushroom:enter} Seta y {ladybug:go under mushroom} se coló bajo su sombrero rojo. {mushroom:face happy} [giggles] —¡Ay, qué cosquillas! Pero {bear:enter} Osito era demasiado grande para esconderse. {bear:face sad} Detrás de Seta no cabía. Detrás de una piedra, tampoco. {bear:sparkle} Entonces se le ocurrió una idea: —¡Si cierro los ojos, nadie me verá! {bear:live nap hold} Cerró los ojos… y se quedó frito. {sfx:snore} Zzz… zzz… —…¡ocho, nueve y DIEZ! {raccoon:live peekaboo resume} ¡Allá voy! {raccoon:face happy} Mapache {raccoon:live listen} aguzó el oído. Zzz… zzz… {raccoon:go to bear} [laughs] —¡Te pillé! {bear:live nap resume} Osito se despertó de un respingo. {bear:face surprised} —¿Cómo lo has sabido? —preguntó. —¡Porque roncabas! —se rió Mapache. {mushroom:live sneeze} A Seta le dio tanta risa que… aaa… aaa… {sfx:achoo} ¡ACHÍS! {ladybug:go back} Y salió Mariquita, gateando. {all:face happy} {all:hop} —¡A ti también te pillé! Ahora le tocaba contar a Osito. —Uno… dos… {bear:live nap hold} tres… [whispers] Zzz. {ladybug:hearts} Así que todos se escondieron, y Osito se echó la mejor siesta del prado.

ja-JP.title: こぐまの かくれんぼ
ja-JP.text: {raccoon:enter}アライグマくんが、いいだしました。[excited]「かくれんぼしよう！ぼくがおに！」 {raccoon:live peekaboo hold}目をかくして、「いーち、にーい、さーん…」 すばやく{ladybug:enter}テントウムシさんが、{mushroom:enter}キノコの{ladybug:go under mushroom}赤いかさの下へ、すっぽり。{mushroom:face happy}[giggles]「くすぐったい！」 でも{bear:enter}こぐまは、大きすぎて、かくれるところがありません。{bear:face sad}キノコのうしろも、だめ。石のうしろも、だめ。{bear:sparkle}そうだ！「目をつぶれば、だれにも見えないよね！」 {bear:live nap hold}目をつぶって…うとうと。{sfx:snore}ぐう…ぐう…「…はーち、きゅーう、じゅう！」 {raccoon:live peekaboo resume}「もういいかい？さがすよー！」 {raccoon:face happy}アライグマくんは、{raccoon:live listen}耳をすませました。ぐう…ぐう…{raccoon:go to bear}[laughs]「みーつけた！」 {bear:live nap resume}こぐまは、はっ！{bear:face surprised}「どうしてわかったの？」 「いびきが、きこえたもん！」 {mushroom:live sneeze}キノコはわらいすぎて…は…は…{sfx:achoo}はっくしょん！{ladybug:go back}テントウムシさんが、ちょこちょこ出てきました。{all:face happy}{all:hop}「みーつけた！」 こんどは、こぐまがおにのばん。「いーち、にーい…」 {bear:live nap hold}「さーん…」 [whispers]ぐう。{ladybug:hearts}みんながかくれているあいだ、こぐまは、さいこうのおひるねをしましたとさ。

de-DE.title: Das Bärchen spielt Verstecken
de-DE.text: {raccoon:enter} Der Waschbär wusste ein Spiel. [excited] „Verstecken! Ich zähle!“ {raccoon:live peekaboo hold} Er hielt sich die Augen zu. „Eins… zwei… drei…“ Blitzschnell entdeckte {ladybug:enter} der Marienkäfer {mushroom:enter} den Pilz und {ladybug:go under mushroom} krabbelte unter seinen roten Hut. {mushroom:face happy} [giggles] „Das kitzelt!“ Aber {bear:enter} das Bärchen war viel zu groß zum Verstecken. {bear:face sad} Nicht hinter dem Pilz. Nicht hinter einem Stein. {bear:sparkle} Da hatte das Bärchen eine Idee. „Wenn ich die Augen zumache, sieht mich keiner!“ {bear:live nap hold} Also machte es die Augen zu… und schlief ein. {sfx:snore} Chrrr… chrrr… „…acht, neun, ZEHN!“ {raccoon:live peekaboo resume} „Ich komme!“ {raccoon:face happy} Der Waschbär {raccoon:live listen} lauschte ganz genau. Chrrr… chrrr… {raccoon:go to bear} [laughs] „Gefunden!“ {bear:live nap resume} Das Bärchen wachte mit einem Ruck auf. {bear:face surprised} „Woher wusstest du das?“, fragte es. „Du hast geschnarcht!“, sagte der Waschbär. {mushroom:live sneeze} Da musste der Pilz so kichern, dass… haa… haaa… {sfx:achoo} HATSCHI! {ladybug:go back} Heraus krabbelte der Marienkäfer. {all:face happy} {all:hop} „Dich hab ich auch!“ Jetzt war das Bärchen mit Zählen dran. „Eins… zwei…“ {bear:live nap hold} „drei…“ [whispers] Chrrr. {ladybug:hearts} Also versteckten sich alle, und das Bärchen machte das schönste Nickerchen auf der ganzen Wiese.

fr-FR.title: Ourson joue à cache-cache
fr-FR.text: {raccoon:enter} Raton laveur voulait jouer. [excited] « À cache-cache ! C’est moi qui compte ! » {raccoon:live peekaboo hold} Il s’est caché les yeux. « Un… deux… trois… » En un clin d’œil, {ladybug:enter} Coccinelle a repéré {mushroom:enter} Champignon et {ladybug:go under mushroom} s’est glissée sous son chapeau rouge. {mushroom:face happy} [giggles] « Ça chatouille ! » Mais {bear:enter} Ourson était bien trop grand pour se cacher. {bear:face sad} Pas derrière Champignon. Pas derrière un rocher. {bear:sparkle} Alors il a eu une idée. « Si je ferme les yeux, personne ne me verra ! » {bear:live nap hold} Il a fermé les yeux… et s’est endormi. {sfx:snore} Zzz… zzz… « …huit, neuf, DIX ! » {raccoon:live peekaboo resume} « Attention, j’arrive ! » {raccoon:face happy} Raton laveur {raccoon:live listen} a tendu l’oreille. Zzz… zzz… {raccoon:go to bear} [laughs] « Trouvé ! » {bear:live nap resume} Ourson s’est réveillé en sursaut. {bear:face surprised} « Comment tu as su ? » « Tu ronflais ! » a ri Raton laveur. {mushroom:live sneeze} Champignon a tellement ri que… ah… ah… {sfx:achoo} ATCHOUM ! {ladybug:go back} Et Coccinelle est sortie de sa cachette. {all:face happy} {all:hop} « Toi aussi, trouvée ! » Ensuite, c’était à Ourson de compter. « Un… deux… » {bear:live nap hold} « trois… » [whispers] Zzz. {ladybug:hearts} Alors tout le monde s’est caché, et Ourson a fait la plus belle sieste du pré.

it-IT.title: Orsetto gioca a nascondino
it-IT.text: {raccoon:enter} Procione aveva un gioco nuovo. [excited] «Nascondino! Conto io!» {raccoon:live peekaboo hold} Si è coperto gli occhi. «Uno… due… tre…» In un batter d'occhio, {ladybug:enter} Coccinella ha visto {mushroom:enter} Fungo e {ladybug:go under mushroom} si è infilata sotto il suo cappello rosso. {mushroom:face happy} [giggles] «Che solletico!» Ma {bear:enter} Orsetto era troppo grande per nascondersi. {bear:face sad} Dietro Fungo, no. Dietro un sasso, nemmeno. {bear:sparkle} Poi gli è venuta un'idea. «Se chiudo gli occhi, nessuno mi vede!» {bear:live nap hold} Così ha chiuso gli occhi… e si è addormentato. {sfx:snore} Ronf… ronf… «…otto, nove, DIECI!» {raccoon:live peekaboo resume} «Chi c'è c'è, chi non c'è non c'è: arrivo!» {raccoon:face happy} Procione {raccoon:live listen} ha teso le orecchie. Ronf… ronf… {raccoon:go to bear} [laughs] «Tana per Orsetto!» {bear:live nap resume} Orsetto si è svegliato di soprassalto. {bear:face surprised} «Come hai fatto?» ha chiesto. «Russavi!» ha detto Procione. {mushroom:live sneeze} Fungo rideva così tanto che… ah… ah… {sfx:achoo} ETCIÙ! {ladybug:go back} E da sotto il cappello è sbucata Coccinella. {all:face happy} {all:hop} «Tana anche per te!» Adesso toccava a Orsetto contare. «Uno… due…» {bear:live nap hold} «tre…» [whispers] Ronf. {ladybug:hearts} Così tutti si sono nascosti, e Orsetto ha fatto il pisolino più bello del prato.

zh-TW.title: 小熊玩躲貓貓
zh-TW.text: {raccoon:enter}浣熊想到一個遊戲。[excited]「來玩躲貓貓！我來數！」 {raccoon:live peekaboo hold}牠蒙住眼睛。「一……二……三……」 {ladybug:enter}瓢蟲動作好快，一眼看見{mushroom:enter}蘑菇，{ladybug:go under mushroom}就鑽進她紅紅的菇傘底下。{mushroom:face happy}[giggles]「好癢喔！」 可是{bear:enter}小熊實在太大了，怎麼躲也躲不起來。{bear:face sad}蘑菇後面，躲不下。石頭後面，也躲不下。{bear:sparkle}這時，牠想到一個好主意：「只要我閉上眼睛，就沒有人看得到我啦！」 {bear:live nap hold}於是牠閉上眼睛……就睡著了。{sfx:snore}呼嚕……呼嚕……「……八、九、十！」 {raccoon:live peekaboo resume}「躲好了沒？我要來找囉！」 {raccoon:face happy}浣熊{raccoon:live listen}豎起耳朵仔細聽。呼嚕……呼嚕……{raccoon:go to bear}[laughs]「找到你了！」 {bear:live nap resume}小熊一下子醒過來。{bear:face surprised}「你怎麼知道？」 牠問。「因為你在打呼呀！」 浣熊說。{mushroom:live sneeze}蘑菇笑得好厲害，結果……哈……哈……{sfx:achoo}哈啾！{ladybug:go back}瓢蟲爬了出來。{all:face happy}{all:hop}「也找到你了！」 現在輪到小熊來數了。「一……二……」 {bear:live nap hold}「三……」 [whispers]呼嚕。{ladybug:hearts}於是大家都躲好了，小熊也睡了整片草地上最香甜的一場午覺。

zh-HK.title: 小熊玩捉迷藏
zh-HK.text: {raccoon:enter}浣熊想到一個遊戲。[excited]「玩捉迷藏！我嚟數！」 {raccoon:live peekaboo hold}牠用手掩住眼睛。「一……二……三……」 {ladybug:enter}瓢蟲一眨眼就看見了{mushroom:enter}蘑菇，{ladybug:go under mushroom}馬上鑽到她紅色的蘑菇帽下面。{mushroom:face happy}[giggles]「哈哈，好痕呀！」 可是{bear:enter}小熊的身子實在太大了，根本無處可躲。{bear:face sad}躲在蘑菇後面？藏不住。躲在石頭後面？也藏不住。{bear:sparkle}這時，牠想到一個好主意：「只要我閉埋眼，就冇人見到我喇！」 {bear:live nap hold}於是牠閉上眼睛……就睡着了。{sfx:snore}呼……呼……「……八、九、十！」 {raccoon:live peekaboo resume}「匿好未呀？我嚟捉喇！」 {raccoon:face happy}浣熊{raccoon:live listen}豎起耳朵，用心地聽。呼……呼……{raccoon:go to bear}[laughs]「捉到你喇！」 {bear:live nap resume}小熊一下子驚醒了。{bear:face surprised}「你點知我喺度㗎？」 牠問。「因為你扯鼻鼾呀！」 浣熊說。{mushroom:live sneeze}蘑菇笑得太厲害，結果……哈……哈……{sfx:achoo}乞嗤！{ladybug:go back}瓢蟲爬了出來。{all:face happy}{all:hop}「又捉到一個！」 現在輪到小熊數了。「一……二……」 {bear:live nap hold}「三……」 [whispers]呼……{ladybug:hearts}於是大家都躲好了，小熊就在草地上，睡了最香甜的一覺。

snore.prompt: a bear cub snoring softly and slowly, cute and cosy
